what: The panel is divided into square cells (96px at 1440 width, 58/375 on mobile), and each cell is covered by four background-colored triangles and a faint diamond line (.3). On open, from the center cell to the outer cells (distance from center ÷ farthest cell × 1s delay), each triangle shrinks to its own corner over 2s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1) (the four staggered by .1s) and the diamond line fades out over 1.5s ease-in. The retreat direction of each cell is randomly one of four, so the grid scatters as if glittering. This is the backdrop curtain of the logo loader

options.cell: Cell size (% of plate width), default 6.6667 — 96px at 1440
options.cell-sp: Cell size (%) when panel width is under 768px, default 15.4667 — 58px at 375
options.dur: Duration for the triangle to close in (sec), default 2
options.fade: Time for the diamond lines to fade out (s), default 1.5
options.step: Stagger of the four triangles within one cell (seconds), default .1
options.wait: Starts once an event with this name fires on document (such as a signal fired after fonts and assets arrive) — if absent, on load
options.--fx-fill · --fx-line: Triangle fill and diamond line colors (via style), default --kf-bg · --kf-ink

note: The grid sits vertically centered in the panel and cells fill from the left (as in the original, on phones 7 cells run slightly past the panel and the right side is cut off). When everything has cleared it fires fx:done on the panel — removing the panel (folding the logo·clearing the white band) is left to the consumer at that time. The original grid image (introgrid.png) is diamond lines touching the cell edges, so it was redrawn as SVG

from.where: shared.js · shared.css .nl-intro__grid (first-visit loader — original introanim__line__grid: cell delay distance ÷ max distance × 1s, triangle clip-path 2s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1) + .1s each, diamond opacity .3→0 over 1.5s cubic-bezier(.895,.03,.685,.22), 10ms after siteready)
